reason: ₹4,999 upfront and then ₹999 every month, forever, is around ₹17,000 in the first year for something my register and WhatsApp already do for free. I don't pay monthly for software, and the free first month doesn't change what I pay after that.
objection: Half my walk-ins won't give their mobile number, so the reminders, the wallet and the top-customer list only work for some of them, and I'd still be paying ₹999 every month.
would_change_my_mind: No monthly fee: one payment of about ₹5,000 to ₹6,000 total, or a few months free so I can first see if my staff use it and if it catches cash missing from the drawer.
